## Problem or Use Case / Problem oder Anwendungsfall
Describe what you want to achieve and which Rinnsal module (`memory`, `tasks`, `connectors`, `auto`, `i18n`, `cli`) is involved.

## Proposed Solution / Vorgeschlagene Lösung
How should it behave (CLI flags, Python API, configuration)? Remember Rinnsal's zero-dependency stdlib-only design.

## Alternatives Considered / Geprüfte Alternativen
Any workarounds or alternative designs you considered.
